title: Florida House, District 76
what_it_does: Represents District 76 (DeSoto and Parts of Charlotte, Lee) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Vanessa Oliver
candidates.occupation: Businesswoman and attorney; state representative for District 76 since 2024
candidates.background: Charlotte County businesswoman with a background in law and as a CEO who was elected to the Florida House in 2024 and is seeking a second term. Her campaign emphasizes protecting agriculture, water quality and cutting taxes.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Voted yes on HJR 1-F in the June 2026 special session, which placed Amendment 3 on the November ballot to raise the homestead exemption for non-school property taxes to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028 and to limit how counties and cities may spend property-tax revenue.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, CS/HJR 1F (Save our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes), passage 75-26

immigration.summary: Voted yes on SB 2-C (2025), which created the State Board of Immigration Enforcement, required state help with federal detainers, barred driver licenses for unauthorized immigrants, and funded an Unauthorized Alien Transport Program. Her website says state and local law enforcement should be allowed to deport people in the country illegally and secure the border.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, SB 2-C (Immigration), passage 85-30

candidates.name: Phillip Carter
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Retired U.S. Air Force security specialist; former movie-theater district manager and subcontractor
candidates.background: Democrat who served six years in the U.S. Air Force, worked in civil law enforcement and movie-theater management and ran his own subcontracting business. He was the 2024 Democratic nominee for state Senate District 27 against Ben Albritton. His HD 76 campaign website currently shows only his name.

abortion.summary: In his 2024 Senate run he supported the constitutional amendment to protect abortion rights, saying the state was taking women's rights away.
